description: Estimate someone's age from their first name within a specific country (e.g., 'US', 'FR', 'JP'). Returns predicted age and regional confidence count.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE") to localize the prediction.

name.description: First name to predict age for.

name: predict_age_country
